scenario: The negative half of LCDB.3.2.3_dwell_on_delay: a fact retracted before the on-delay has passed ends the match, and nothing fires (LCDB.3.2.3). Drives the same `dwell` test CE, with the retraction removing the token before any tick can satisfy it. Pin: set 0; assert Motion; pump; advance 1_s, pump; retract; advance 5_s, pump. No messages.
rules_ds:
schema Motion scope logical:
    zone: String key
    ts: Time

rule settled:
    Motion m where m.dwell >= 2_s
->
    log critical "settled"
